units.summary: CompactStaleHead now runs through the shared compactHeadViewLocked helper and uses NewSelectedSeriesHead rather than NewStaleHead. Eviction now passes a committedAppendID watermark, so series that got samples after compaction started are skipped. Each chunk range gets a fresh BlockMeta, and ranges with no data are skipped without a reload.
units.headline: Stale head compaction rerouted through shared head-view helper with watermark
units.reason: Changes which series get evicted and how block bounds are computed in a data-loss-sensitive path.
focus: NewSelectedSeriesHead over the stale refs writes the same chunks the old NewStaleHead did, including boundary samples
view.Meta().MaxTime+1 equals the old staleHead.BlockMaxTime() for every chunk range
With the appendID watermark, series that get late samples stay in the head and their numStaleSeries accounting is still correct

units.summary: Blocks tagged FromSelectedSeries no longer count toward the in-order max time, which sets the WAL-replay and head-truncation cutoff. This matches the existing exclusions for stale-series and out-of-order blocks.
units.headline: inOrderBlocksMaxTime excludes from-selected-series blocks
units.reason: Changes the head truncation and WAL-replay cutoff, which decides whether data survives.
focus: The planner and CompactBlockMetas keep the selected-series hint through merges, so merged blocks stay excluded

units.summary: Two tests were removed from this spot, TestStaleBlockNotMergedWithNonStaleBlock and TestOutOfOrderBlockMergePreservesHint. They are re-added elsewhere in the file with the same bodies, only their doc comments differ, so no coverage is lost.
